extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: electric centrifugal water pump on base frame, 1.2 m long, approx. 0.85 m tall
extras.notes: end suction pump: teal electric motor with cooling fins, fan cowl with grille, terminal box and lifting eye; yellow coupling guard; steel bearing bracket and spiral volute casing with axial suction nozzle (+X) and vertical discharge nozzle, both flanged with hex nuts; pressure gauge with tick scale and no numbers on the discharge side; dark base frame with anchor nuts; shaft axis along X at 0.40 m; front = -Y; no moving parts; no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
